title: 停下来读一步
description: 木炭与淡彩记录成人低位停顿、观察下一组手脚点的瞬间。

art_direction.medium: crisp digital comic ink and quiet halftone shadows
art_direction.scene: An original charcoal-and-wash illustration depicts a fictional adult pausing midway through a compact low bouldering line to study the next hand and foot options. One hand rests on a positive lavender hold, both shoes engage clearly separated low footholds, and the free hand stays relaxed near the body. The next route section curves sideways rather than upward, keeping the figure close to the continuous padded landing. Use a medium-wide profile view with loose charcoal contours, pale lavender washes, and soft window light. Preserve natural adult proportions, opaque clothing, and credible points of contact. No written route labels, brand marks, jumping, bystanders below, or dramatic height.
